name: NaturalQuestions
intro: NaturalQuestions 是报告中用于检索增强问答和开放域问答的真实搜索问题数据集。
build_method: 真实搜索查询, Wikipedia配对, 人工长短答案标注
task_type: 知识问答, 检索问答
build_method_en: Real search queries, Wikipedia pairing, human long/short answer annotation
intro_en: NaturalQuestions is a real search-query QA dataset referenced by reports for retrieval-augmented and open-domain question answering.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the primary TACL paper at ACL Anthology Q19-1026. Natural Questions samples anonymized, aggregated Google queries of at least eight words issued by multiple users, applies question-form heuristics, and keeps queries with a Wikipedia page in the top five results. About 50 annotators first judge question validity without seeing the page, then select the earliest smallest long-answer HTML box or NULL, followed by short entity spans, yes/no, or no short answer. The release has 307,373 single-annotated training examples and five-way Dev/Test sets of 7,830/7,842. With beta=2, at least two non-null annotations require an answer matching any reference; otherwise the system must return NULL. Long and short answers report precision, recall, and F1 separately.
